pattern_description: Multi-card syndicate operating through shared device profile (Unknown | Unknown | chrome 66.0 | Unknown) across 175 distinct cards and 171 customers, operating behind an anonymous proxy and linked to 1120 prior closed fraud cases.
sar_narrative:
SUSPICIOUS ACTIVITY REPORT (SAR) NARRATIVE
Case Reference: HHG-008
Subject Customer: C13171 | Subject Card: C13171-K2
Activity Period: 2016-12-20 03:08:56 | Cumulative Exposure: $55.68
Primary Typology: UNDOCUMENTED

1. EXECUTIVE SUMMARY:
Financial institution automated graph surveillance identified organized anomalous activity involving customer C13171 and card C13171-K2, resulting in cumulative suspicious exposure of $55.68 across transaction(s) 3558054.

2. GRAPH & DEVICE TOPOLOGY ANALYSIS:
Graph traversal revealed that transaction 3558054 originated from device profile 'Unknown | Unknown | chrome 66.0 | Unknown' (Device ID: DEV_ecaae88a99a0). Graph topological queries confirmed this exact device profile is shared across 175 distinct cardholder accounts and is connected to 1120 previously confirmed fraud case(s) (CC-1747, CC-2404, CC-1273, CC-2525). Activity exhibited proxy masking characteristics (Proxy status: ).

3. POLICY COMPLIANCE & ACTIONS TAKEN:
In accordance with Fraud Policy v1.0 (Rules R6, R8, R9), the institution initiated immediate defensive card blocks, escalated the case to Senior Fraud Management (Level 2 Approval), and filed this formal FinCEN SAR.

evidence.claim: Device profile (Unknown | Unknown | chrome 66.0 | Unknown) is shared across 175 cards and 171 distinct customers, linked to 1120 historical fraud cases (CC-1747, CC-2404, CC-1273)

containment_steps: Immediate hard block on primary compromised card C13171-K2
Identify and freeze all companion cards sharing device profile across graph
Add device hardware fingerprint and proxy IP ranges to real-time blacklists
Revoke active web/mobile banking sessions for affected accounts

customer_communication.message_copy: Dear Cardholder, we detected unauthorized activity on your card ending in 1-K2. For your security, we have placed a hold on the card. A fraud specialist will contact you to reissue a new card.

financial_remediation: Issue provisional credit to affected cardholder(s)
Waive all associated late fees or overdraft charges
compliance_actions: File FinCEN Suspicious Activity Report (SAR) under Rule R9 (Organized Proxy Syndicate)
Escalate case dossier to Senior Fraud Operations & Legal Compliance (Level 2 Approval)
Write finalized investigation dossier and syndicate links back to TigerGraph
